findings.summary: Exported C0/Delete helper has no production consumer.
findings.consequence: The repository carries and tests a public helper that currently does not protect any runtime boundary, so future readers must distinguish it from the actually used C0/C1 and HTML-safety predicates without behavioral benefit.
findings.evidence: The owned unit is exported at line 1, but a repository search for `hasC0OrDelete` outside prior review artifacts found only `shared/utils/text-safety.ts` and `test/unit/text-safety.spec.ts`; the packet-listed production importers use `hasC0OrC1Control`, `hasHtmlUnsafeCodeUnit`, `hasLoneSurrogate`, or other helpers instead.
findings.recommendation: Delete `hasC0OrDelete` and remove its dedicated expectations from `test/unit/text-safety.spec.ts`, unless a concrete production boundary needs exactly C0 plus U+007F but not C1 controls.
